[[File:Jewellery Enchantments interface.png|thumb|The Jewellery Enchantments interface.]]
'''Jewellery Enchantments''' are a set of [[enchantment spells]] on the [[standard spellbook]] used specifically for gold and silver jewellery with gemstones to give the item new properties.

Unlike [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt]], Jewellery Enchantments is not a single spell, but exists as a subpage of the standard spellbook, and houses the seven enchantment spells used for jewellery. Each spell requires different [[Magic]] levels for casting, as well as a suitable jewellery item. It is accessible for both [[free-to-play]] and [[members]], though free-to-play players may only use the first four levels of enchantments and can only enchant into items that are also free-to-play.
